Name: Ziph in the Negev
ModernLocation: Unknown; possibly Khirbet ez Zeifeh, in the Negev
Description: A town in Judah's Negev list, distinct from the Ziph of the Judean hills whose people betrayed David to Saul.
BiblicalSignificance: Ziph in the Negev is the southern namesake of David's Ziph, preserved only in the allotment list.
